# Experiment Insights and Statistical Safeguards
Date: 2026-11-20 | Duration: 36.29999923706055m

## Summary
Plans for results surfacing focus on punchier experiment summaries and highlights that replace dashboard-first viewing, with goal metrics included and secondary results filtered. Statistical safeguards remain central: multiple-comparison concerns, stricter surfacing rules, and strict thresholds for surprising slices, negative subgroup effects, and lower-credibility outliers. A Signals page is likely to ship first, using pre-specified dimensions and ranked findings; precomputed dimensions limit coverage, while configurable setup and existing dashboards provide fallback options. API advisories are proposed for agent consumption, with severity, plain-text messages, and supporting data paths. Interpretation rules currently encoded in skills may move server-side into centralized heuristic or LLM-based logic; hypermedia links for next steps were discussed but applicability is unconfirmed. Product work includes a live experiment redesign with inline editing and improved flag management, feature flags in A/B testing, a review publishing redesign led by Gaia, and governance controls for SDK connections, including revisions, rollback, and webhook versioning. Source: Results Surfacing, API Advisories, Statistical Interpretation, and Product UI Redesign.

## Keywords
Experiment summarisation, Signals, Advisories API, Statistical safeguards, Feature-flag redesign, SDK governance
